title.narrative: TB Innovations and Health Systems Strengthening (TB Innovations)

description.narrative: (Philippines): .USAID, through the TB Innovations activity, will strengthen implementation of the Philippine Strategic TB Elimination Plan by supporting the Department of Health (DOH) to scale up high impact interventions designed to prevent, detect, and treat TB. These interventions will also strengthen the capacity of local partners. This activity contributes to the U.S. foreign policy priority to defend the U.S. from the spread of deadly infectious diseases and its interventions align with USAID's Global Accelerator to End TB...USAID will assist the DOH to reach the pre-COVID-19 performance level of the National Tuberculosis Control Program on key indicators, including TB notification. USAID will implement the integrated testing approach to detect COVID-19 and TB and continue to support the "screen all" approach for all patients visiting health facilities. USAID will help expand a network of laboratories and optimize capacities of diagnostic facilities to provide comprehensive and high-quality TB diagnostic services, including use of chest X-rays as a screening tool and scale up of rapid diagnostic tests as a primary diagnostic tool. USAID will support the adoption and scale up of new tools, including use of ultra portable X-rays and Truenat for TB testing. USAID will support adoption and scale up of digital adherence tools to improve treatment compliance. FY 2022 funds will also support the modeling of integrated local health systems under the Universal Health Care law framework, including the provision of primary care packages, establishment of health care provider networks, advancement in cooperative and transparent governance, and development of efficient pooling of resources. USAID will also strengthen the National Coordinating Committee to oversee progress and ensure achievement of targets, engage the private sector to improve its capacity and access to affordable diagnostic equipment and supplies, and institutionalize policies to reduce TB transmission...
